title: Finerenone in chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes: a living meta-analysis of cardiovascular and kidney outcomes

pico.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (albuminuria)
pico.comparator: Placebo on standard of care (RAS blockade)
outcomes: Primary: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, or hospitalization for heart failure
Secondary: kidney composite (kidney failure, >=40% eGFR decline, renal death)

primary_outcome: Composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, or hospitalization for heart failure

search.strategy: finerenone AND (chronic kidney disease OR diabetic nephropathy) — registry frame then OA full text
